title: Exceptions
explanation: When something goes wrong Java throws an exception, and everything after the failing line is skipped. catch lets you decide what happens instead of the program dying.
Catch the narrowest type you can. NumberFormatException tells you the text was not a number; catching plain Exception hides which of a dozen things broke.

finally runs either way, success or failure - the place for cleanup. And a custom exception like BuildException is just a class that extends Exception, which makes your own failures as readable as the built-in ones.
